# Semgrep findings judged harmless, and files Semgrep can't parse, each with
# the reason. Used by .github/scripts/security-scan.sh, which fails on any
# finding or unparsed file not listed here, on any time-out, and on any entry
# here that no longer matches (a stale entry would hide whatever came to
# match it).
#
# One per line, fields separated by single tabs, LF line endings:
#   finding  <rule>  <file>  <SHA-256 of the lines it covers>  <reason>
#   unparsed  <file>  <Semgrep's error type>  <reason>
# <rule> is the last part of Semgrep's rule id. The hash is of the lines the
# finding covers, each with white space at either end trimmed, joined by
# newlines. To get it, run the scan on your own computer with
# .github/scripts/scan-locally.sh semgrep: each finding not listed is printed
# with its rule, file, line and hash. Add it here, with a reason, in a pull
# request; the scan on GitHub prints only rule, file and line.
